WITH state_counts AS (
    SELECT
        'state' AS geographic_level,
        COALESCE(c.customer_state, 'Unknown') AS location_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customer_count
    FROM customers AS c
    GROUP BY
        COALESCE(c.customer_state, 'Unknown')
),
city_counts AS (
    SELECT
        'city' AS geographic_level,
        COALESCE(c.customer_city, 'Unknown') AS location_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customer_count
    FROM customers AS c
    GROUP BY
        COALESCE(c.customer_city, 'Unknown')
)
SELECT
    geographic_level,
    location_name,
    customer_count
FROM state_counts
UNION ALL
SELECT
    geographic_level,
    location_name,
    customer_count
FROM city_counts
ORDER BY
    geographic_level,
    customer_count DESC,
    location_name;
